Description
Kingston University London's roots go back to the Kingston Technical Institute, founded in 1899. Kingston has 16,820 students and specializes in the arts, design, fashion, science, engineering, and business. In 2017, the university won The Guardian University Award for teaching excellence.
The International Foundation Year is for international students who want a well-rounded, supportive introduction to an undergraduate degree at Kingston University, London. Taught in three interesting subject pathways, this program will help you transition into university lifestyle and ensure your success while studying abroad.
